#!/bin/bash

# setup_ssh_tunnel.sh - Script to create SSH tunnels for secure data transfer

# Configuration variables
# Modify these values to match your setup
REMOTE_HOST=""
REMOTE_USER=""
LOCAL_PORT=8080
REMOTE_PORT=80
TUNNEL_TYPE="local"  # "local" or "remote"
SSH_KEY_PATH=""  # Optional: specify path to SSH private key

# Display usage information
usage() {
    echo "Usage: $0 [OPTIONS]"
    echo "Set up SSH tunnel for secure data transfer."
    echo ""
    echo "OPTIONS:"
    echo "  -h HOST     Remote server hostname or IP address"
    echo "  -u USER     Remote username"
    echo "  -l PORT     Local port to bind (default: 8080)"
    echo "  -r PORT     Remote port to connect to (default: 80)"
    echo "  -t TYPE     Tunnel type: \"local\" or \"remote\" (default: local)"
    echo "  -k KEY      Path to SSH private key"
    echo "  -h         Show this help message"
    echo ""
    echo "Example: $0 -h 192.168.1.100 -u john -l 8080 -r 80"
    exit 1
}

# Parse command line arguments
while getopts "h:u:l:r:t:k:-" opt; do
    case $opt in
        h) REMOTE_HOST="$OPTARG" ;;
        u) REMOTE_USER="$OPTARG" ;;
        l) LOCAL_PORT="$OPTARG" ;;
        r) REMOTE_PORT="$OPTARG" ;;
        t) TUNNEL_TYPE="$OPTARG" ;;
        k) SSH_KEY_PATH="$OPTARG" ;;
        ?) usage ;;
    esac
done

# Validate required parameters
if [ -z "$REMOTE_HOST" ] || [ -z "$REMOTE_USER" ]; then
    echo "Error: Remote host and username are required."
    usage
fi

# Validate tunnel type
if [[ "$TUNNEL_TYPE" != "local" && "$TUNNEL_TYPE" != "remote" ]]; then
    echo "Error: Tunnel type must be \"local\" or \"remote\"."
    exit 1
fi

# Build SSH command based on tunnel type
SSH_CMD="ssh"

# Add key file if specified
if [ -n "$SSH_KEY_PATH" ]; then
    if [ ! -f "$SSH_KEY_PATH" ]; then
        echo "Error: SSH key file not found: $SSH_KEY_PATH"
        exit 1
    fi
    SSH_CMD="$SSH_CMD -i $SSH_KEY_PATH"
fi

# Add common SSH options for tunneling
# -N: Do not execute remote command (just forward ports)
# -T: Disable pseudo-terminal allocation
# -o ExitOnForwardFailure=yes: Exit if port forwarding fails
SSH_CMD="$SSH_CMD -N -T -o ExitOnForwardFailure=yes"

# Construct the port forwarding argument based on tunnel type
if [ "$TUNNEL_TYPE" = "local" ]; then
    FORWARD_ARG="-L $LOCAL_PORT:localhost:$REMOTE_PORT"
    echo "Setting up LOCAL tunnel:"
    echo "  Local:  localhost:$LOCAL_PORT"
    echo "  Remote: $REMOTE_HOST:$REMOTE_PORT"
else
    FORWARD_ARG="-R $REMOTE_PORT:localhost:$LOCAL_PORT"
    echo "Setting up REMOTE tunnel:"
    echo "  Remote: $REMOTE_HOST:$REMOTE_PORT"
    echo "  Local:  localhost:$LOCAL_PORT"
fi

# Complete SSH command
SSH_CMD="$SSH_CMD $FORWARD_ARG $REMOTE_USER@$REMOTE_HOST"

echo ""
echo "Executing SSH tunnel command:"
echo "$SSH_CMD"

# Execute the SSH tunnel command
$SSH_CMD

# Check the exit status
if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "SSH tunnel closed successfully."
else
    echo "SSH tunnel encountered an error."
    exit 1
fi

#!/bin/bash

# verify_remote_transfer.sh - Script to verify data transfer to remote storage

# Configuration (these should be set based on your setup)
REMOTE_HOST=""
REMOTE_USER=""
REMOTE_PATH="/backup"
SSH_KEY_PATH=""
ARCHIVE_DIR="/root/.openclaw/workspace/backups"
LOG_FILE="/root/.openclaw/workspace/logs/transfer_verification.log"

# Function to log messages
log_message() {
    echo "[$(date -u)] $1" | tee -a "$LOG_FILE"
}

# Function to display usage
usage() {
    cat << EOF
Usage: $0 [OPTIONS]
Verify that archived data has been successfully transferred to remote storage.

OPTIONS:
  -h HOST     Remote server hostname or IP address
  -u USER     Remote username
  -p PATH     Remote path where backups are stored (default: /backup)
  -k KEY      Path to SSH private key
  -l LOCAL    Local archive directory (default: /root/.openclaw/workspace/backups)
  -H         Show this help message

Example: $0 -h backup-server.com -u john -p /backups
EOF
    exit 1
}

# Parse command line arguments
while getopts "h:u:p:k:l:H" opt; do
    case $opt in
        h) REMOTE_HOST="$OPTARG" ;;
        u) REMOTE_USER="$OPTARG" ;;
        p) REMOTE_PATH="$OPTARG" ;;
        k) SSH_KEY_PATH="$OPTARG" ;;
        l) ARCHIVE_DIR="$OPTARG" ;;
        H) usage ;;
        ?) usage ;;
    esac
done

# Validate required parameters
if [ -z "$REMOTE_HOST" ] || [ -z "$REMOTE_USER" ]; then
    log_message "Error: Remote host and username are required."
    usage
fi

# Check if local archive directory exists
if [ ! -d "$ARCHIVE_DIR" ]; then
    log_message "Error: Local archive directory does not exist: $ARCHIVE_DIR"
    exit 1
fi

log_message "Starting verification of remote data transfer"
log_message "Local archive directory: $ARCHIVE_DIR"
log_message "Remote destination: $REMOTE_USER@$REMOTE_HOST:$REMOTE_PATH"

# Build SCP command with optional key
SCP_CMD="scp"
if [ -n "$SSH_KEY_PATH" ]; then
    if [ ! -f "$SSH_KEY_PATH" ]; then
        log_message "Error: SSH key file not found: $SSH_KEY_PATH"
        exit 1
    fi
    SCP_CMD="$SCP_CMD -i $SSH_KEY_PATH"
fi
SCP_CMD="$SCP_CMD -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no"

# Build SSH command for remote operations
SSH_CMD="ssh"
if [ -n "$SSH_KEY_PATH" ]; then
    SSH_CMD="$SSH_CMD -i $SSH_KEY_PATH"
fi
SSH_CMD="$SSH_CMD -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no"

# Get list of local archive files
LOCAL_FILES=$(find "$ARCHIVE_DIR" -name "system_backup_*.tar.gz" | sort)

if [ -z "$LOCAL_FILES" ]; then
    log_message "No archive files found in $ARCHIVE_DIR"
    exit 1
fi

# Initialize counters
success_count=0
fail_count=0

# Verify each local archive file
for ARCHIVE_PATH in $LOCAL_FILES; do
    ARCHIVE_NAME=$(basename "$ARCHIVE_PATH")
    log_message "Verifying $ARCHIVE_NAME"
    
    # Get local file size and checksum
    LOCAL_SIZE=$(stat -c %s "$ARCHIVE_PATH" 2>/dev/null || ls -la "$ARCHIVE_PATH" | awk '{print $5}')
    LOCAL_CHECKSUM=$(sha256sum "$ARCHIVE_PATH" | cut -d' ' -f1)
    
    log_message "  Local size: $LOCAL_SIZE bytes"
    log_message "  Local SHA256: $LOCAL_CHECKSUM"
    
    # Check if file exists on remote server and get its size and checksum
    REMOTE_EXISTS=$(echo "test -f '$REMOTE_PATH/$ARCHIVE_NAME' && echo exists" | $SSH_CMD $REMOTE_USER@$REMOTE_HOST 2>/dev/null)
    
    if [ "$REMOTE_EXISTS" = "exists" ]; then
        REMOTE_SIZE=$(echo "stat -c %s '$REMOTE_PATH/$ARCHIVE_NAME'" | $SSH_CMD $REMOTE_USER@$REMOTE_HOST 2>/dev/null)
        REMOTE_CHECKSUM=$(echo "sha256sum '$REMOTE_PATH/$ARCHIVE_NAME' | cut -d' ' -f1" | $SSH_CMD $REMOTE_USER@$REMOTE_HOST 2>/dev/null)
        
        log_message "  Remote size: $REMOTE_SIZE bytes"
        log_message "  Remote SHA256: $REMOTE_CHECKSUM"
        
        # Compare sizes and checksums
        if [ "$LOCAL_SIZE" = "$REMOTE_SIZE" ] && [ "$LOCAL_CHECKSUM" = "$REMOTE_CHECKSUM" ]; then
            log_message "  VERIFICATION SUCCESS: $ARCHIVE_NAME matches on remote server"
            success_count=$((success_count + 1))
        else
            log_message "  VERIFICATION FAILED: Size or checksum mismatch for $ARCHIVE_NAME"
            fail_count=$((fail_count + 1))
        fi
    else
        log_message "  File not found on remote server: $ARCHIVE_NAME"
        fail_count=$((fail_count + 1))
    fi
    
    echo "" >> "$LOG_FILE"
done

# Summarize results
log_message "Verification complete: $success_count successful, $fail_count failed"

echo ""
if [ $fail_count -eq 0 ]; then
    log_message "ALL FILES VERIFIED SUCCESSFULLY"
    exit 0
else
    log_message "VERIFICATION FAILED: $fail_count files not properly transferred"
    exit 1
fi

Example: $0 -h backup-server.com -u john -p /backups
EOF
    exit 1
}

# Parse command line arguments
while getopts "h:u:p:k:l:H" opt; do
    case $opt in
        h) REMOTE_HOST="$OPTARG" ;;
        u) REMOTE_USER="$OPTARG" ;;
        p) REMOTE_PATH="$OPTARG" ;;
        k) SSH_KEY_PATH="$OPTARG" ;;
        l) ARCHIVE_DIR="$OPTARG" ;;
        H) usage ;;
        ?) usage ;;
    esac
done

# Validate required parameters
if [ -z "$REMOTE_HOST" ] || [ -z "$REMOTE_USER" ]; then
    log_message "Error: Remote host and username are required."
    usage
fi

# Check if local archive directory exists
if [ ! -d "$ARCHIVE_DIR" ]; then
    log_message "Error: Local archive directory does not exist: $ARCHIVE_DIR"
    exit 1
fi

# Create remote directory if it doesn't exist
SSH_CMD="ssh"
if [ -n "$SSH_KEY_PATH" ]; then
    if [ ! -f "$SSH_KEY_PATH" ]; then
        log_message "Error: SSH key file not found: $SSH_KEY_PATH"
        exit 1
    fi
    SSH_CMD="$SSH_CMD -i $SSH_KEY_PATH"
fi
SSH_CMD="$SSH_CMD -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no"

log_message "Creating remote directory $REMOTE_PATH if it doesn't exist"
echo "mkdir -p '$REMOTE_PATH'" | $SSH_CMD $REMOTE_USER@$REMOTE_HOST

# Build SCP command
SCP_CMD="scp"
if [ -n "$SSH_KEY_PATH" ]; then
    SCP_CMD="$SCP_CMD -i $SSH_KEY_PATH"
fi
SCP_CMD="$SCP_CMD -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o ConnectTimeout=30"

# Get list of archive files that haven't been transferred yet
# We'll use a marker file to track what has been transferred
TRANSFER_LOG="$ARCHIVE_DIR/.transferred"
if [ ! -f "$TRANSFER_LOG" ]; then
    touch "$TRANSFER_LOG"
fi

log_message "Starting transfer process"
log_message "Source: $ARCHIVE_DIR"
log_message "Destination: $REMOTE_USER@$REMOTE_HOST:$REMOTE_PATH"

# Find archive files and transfer them if not already transferred
find "$ARCHIVE_DIR" -name "system_backup_*.tar.gz" -type f | sort | while read ARCHIVE_PATH; do
    ARCHIVE_NAME=$(basename "$ARCHIVE_PATH")
    
    # Check if this file has already been transferred
    if grep -q "$ARCHIVE_NAME" "$TRANSFER_LOG"; then
        log_message "Skipping $ARCHIVE_NAME (already transferred)"
        continue
    fi
    
    log_message "Transferring $ARCHIVE_NAME"
    
    # Transfer the file
    $SCP_CMD "$ARCHIVE_PATH" "$REMOTE_USER@$REMOTE_HOST:$REMOTE_PATH/"
    
    if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
        log_message "Successfully transferred $ARCHIVE_NAME"
        # Mark this file as transferred
        echo "$ARCHIVE_NAME" >> "$TRANSFER_LOG"
    else
        log_message "Failed to transfer $ARCHIVE_NAME"
        # Try to remove partial file on remote server
        echo "rm -f '$REMOTE_PATH/$ARCHIVE_NAME'" | $SSH_CMD $REMOTE_USER@$REMOTE_HOST
    fi
done

log_message "Transfer process completed"
